```lean
theorem gradedCommAux_lof_tmul (i j : ι) (a : 𝒜 i) (b : ℬ j) :
    gradedCommAux R 𝒜 ℬ (lof R _ 𝒜ℬ (i, j) (a ⊗ₜ b)) =
      (-1 : ℤˣ)^(j * i) • lof R _ ℬ𝒜 (j, i) (b ⊗ₜ a) := by
  rw [gradedCommAux]
  dsimp
  simp [mul_comm i j]

@[simp]
```
